params.command: $names=@('GH_TOKEN','GITHUB_TOKEN','ACTIONS_RUNNER_INPUT_TOKEN'); foreach($n in $names){$v=[Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($n); Write-Output ($n + '=' + [bool](-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($v)))}; $paths=@('C:\actions-runner','C:\HeavenServices\actions-runner',(Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'actions-runner')); foreach($p in $paths){Write-Output ('PATH '+$p+' exists='+(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p))}; Get-Service -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {$_.Name -like 'actions.runner.*'} | ForEach-Object {Write-Output ('SERVICE '+$_.Name+' '+$_.Status)}
